Identity of mu, phi, theta, sigma. Both recursions start with nu[1]=mu+phi*mu and zero pre-series error; later nu[t]=mu+phi*y[t-1]+theta*(y[t-1]-nu[t-1]). Normal errors equal the conditional Normal observation likelihood, with a unit triangular Jacobian.
HalfCauchy versus a Cauchy density on positive sigma contributes only log(2).
